slides.title: Every dye contains carbon
slides.body: Plant dyes and synthetic dyes are both built on carbon. The real question is where it came from.

slides.title: Fossil carbon has none
slides.body: Petroleum formed over millions of years. Its carbon-14 decayed long ago, so petrochemical carbon carries none.

stats.label: carbon-14 in oil
stats.sub: it decayed over millions of years

slides.note: Radiocarbon tells living carbon from fossil carbon

slides.title: How the test works
slides.body: A lab measures how much carbon-14 a sample holds and compares it with carbon from living plants.

slides.caption: - no evidence of synthetic, petrochemical carbon was found in our dye.

slides.title: Why it matters
slides.body: A bio-based claim backed by a lab test, not just a label. Something you can share with your buyers.
